purpose: Final frozen fixed-Taylor3 auxiliary temperature evaluation; not VDF repair or a tuning criterion
reporting: all_finite MAE includes finite negative temperatures. Nonnegative-only errors, negative and nonfinite counts are separate. Original truth is manifest actual_temperature_ev, not configured targets. True-Fourier Taylor3 quantifies fixed-window estimator bias.

bootstrap.method: Paired percentile bootstrap; identical physical sample indices for every species and estimator; finite negative temperatures are included. CIs use the common finite subset for each species.
bootstrap.interpretation: Conditional uncertainty for frozen estimators/model on iid sampled synthetic states; excludes selection and retraining uncertainty. Method point statistics outside bootstrap retain each estimator own finite subset.

postprocessing: No VDF or Fourier coefficients changed
